can hear the faint sounds of a village.

You tread through the deep, dark forest on a dimly lit path.  The forest
here seems less dense than to the south.  Northward you see the faint outline
of a village.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dimly lit path leads to a village.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1102 to 1103

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand at the entrance to the Shire.  You see halflings, no more than
wee tall, every which way you look. Bywater Road leads east and west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1103 to 1104

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south you see a dimly lit path which leads to a dense forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1103 to 1102

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1103 to 1118

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Entrance to the Shire

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west while to the north lies the general store.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The general store lies to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1104 to 1105

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1104 to 1106

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1104 to 1103

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bywater Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside the general store.  All sorts of goodies are stacked on the
many shelves.  Your local friendly shopkeeper is smiling patiently, waiting to
serve you to the best of his abilities.  The only exit is to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit lies to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1105 to 1104

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The General Store

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west.  To the north, steps lead to a friendly looking
weaponry/armory while a nursery lies to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Steps lead to a friendly looking weaponry and armory.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1106 to 1107

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1106 to 1109

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south lies Kid'n Keep, the local nursery.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1106 to 1108

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1106 to 1104

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bywater Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside the finest weapons and armour shop in all of Shiredom.  The
shopkeeper proudly displays his fine wares and humbly offers the best daggers
that you have ever laid eyes on.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit lies to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1107 to 1106

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The House of Arms

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside Kid'n Keep, the convenient one-stop nursery that maintains
the youth of the Shire.  Toddlers run every which way while their nursemaids
sigh in exasperation.  The only exit lies to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit lies to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1108 to 1106

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Kid'n Keep

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Bywater Road continues west and south.  A large, imposing building lies
to the east.  Farther to the south, you can see an Inn of some sort.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A large, imposing building lies to the east.  A sign reads 'Shiriff Post'.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1109 to 1110

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1109 to 1112

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1109 to 1106

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A bend in the road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the Shiriff Post which acts as the nucleus for the three shiriffs
of the Eastern Shire.  As you examine the shiriffs on duty, you come to realize
that the halflings of the Shire are not to be reckoned with.  You cower with
awe.  A door offers passage to the east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A door offers passage to the office of the Thain.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 1110 to 1111

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west you can see Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1110 to 1109

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Shiriff Post of the Eastern Shire

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand inside the office of the Thain, the police protectorate of the
great Shire.  The Thain has sworn to protect the Shire from all thieves and
murderers with his life, and so eyes you suspiciously.  A door to the west
leads to the Shiriff Post.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A door offers passage to the Shiriff Post.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 1111 to 1110

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Thain's Office

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the north and south.  To the east you spy the training grounds for
shiriffs in training.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the north runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1112 to 1109

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Shiriff Training Grounds lies to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1112 to 1117

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1112 to 1113

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bywater Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the north.  The private residences of Shire inhabitants are to
the east and west while to the south lies the Ivy Bush, second only to the
Green Dragon for its hospitality and service.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the north runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1113 to 1112

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You spy the private dwelling of a Shire folk to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1113 to 1115

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
To the south you see the Ivy Bush, a favorite haunt of Shire urbanites and
seasoned travelers.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1113 to 1116

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You spy the private dwelling of a Shire folk to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1113 to 1114

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bywater Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside a smial, a hole in the ground which serves as the proper
dwelling place for halflings.  As you look around this private abode, you feel
as if you were intruding and so quickly cover your eyes.  The only exit lies
to the east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit lies to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1114 to 1113

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A smial

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside a smial, a hole in the ground which serves as the proper
dwelling place for halflings.  As you look around this private abode, you feel
as if you were intruding and so quickly cover your eyes.  The only exit lies
to the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit lies to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1115 to 1113

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A smial

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the Ivy Bush, one of the most famous inns in all of Shiredom.
Chique Shire urbanites and seasoned travelers fill the confines of the room
with gay and lively talk.  A jovial innkeeper stops all that he is doing to
await your command.  The only exit lies to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit lies to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1116 to 1113

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Ivy Bush

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The sounds of mock battle and feigned death cries fill your ears.  Every
which way you turn you see halfling trainees at the prime of their youth.  A
wizened old battle instructor meets your gaze and asks if he may be of
service.  The only exit lies to the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit lies to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1117 to 1112

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Shiriff Training Grounds

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west.  A large, imposing building lies to the south.
You catch a glimpse of the Brandywine River to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east you see the entrance to the Shire.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1118 to 1103

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A large, imposing building lies to the south.  A sign reads 'Shiriff Post'.

You are in the Shiriff Post which acts as the nucleus for the three shiriffs
of the Bridge.  As you examine the shiriffs on duty, you come to realize that
the halflings of the Shire are not to be reckoned with.  You cower with awe.
The only exit is to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit is to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1119 to 1118

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Shiriff Post of the Bridge

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east and west.  To the south you spy the Grocer's Delight,
the premium grocer's shop in all the realm while to the north lies Brandywine
Bridge.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Brandywine Bridge offers safe passage across the tumultuous river.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1120 to 1131

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1120 to 1118

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the Grocer's Delight to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1120 to 1121

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1120 to 1122

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bywater Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You tremble with ecstasy as the tempting odors of freshly made pipeweed
bread fill your lungs.  Rumor has it that the pipeweed bread sold here can
restore vitality.  You look around but find no one to take your order.
You then peep over the counter and discover a friendly grocer who is too
short to be seen over the counter.  The only exit is to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The only exit is to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1121 to 1120

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Grocer's Delight

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on Bywater Road, the busiest street in all of Shiredom.  The road
continues to the east.  A small hill lies to the west while you can see a
watermill to the far south.  You catch a glimpse of the Brandywine River to
the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1122 to 1120

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: An entrance to the watermill lies to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1122 to 1123

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small hill to the west blocks your view.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1122 to 1126

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bywater Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand at the entrance to a watermill.  You hear the bustle of busy
workers and the sound of a creaking mill.  Bywater Road is to the north while
the watermill continues to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Bywater Road to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1123 to 1122

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A watermill meets your gaze.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1123 to 1124

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Entrance to Watermill

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Halfling workers are scattered everywhere, busy at work.  You see the river
to the west and get a compelling urge to grab the nearest worker and to toss
him into the river.  The entrance stands to the north while a door offers
passage to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the entrance.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1124 to 1123

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A wooden door leads to the rear of the watermill.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 1124 to 1125

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Watermill

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a damp, dimly lit room.  Mildew clings to the walls and it
appears as if you were the first person to enter the room in ages.  A barely
visible portal in the ground catches your eye.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A watermill meets your gaze.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1125 to 1124

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A hidden portal reveals a passageway down.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1125 to 1146

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Rear of watermill

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on top of Took Hill, named after the legendary Bandobras Took.
You feel honored to be standing on a hill named after your hero.  From this
vantage point you can see all of shiredom.  You get the feeling that with
one stomp you could eliminate their great city.  You can see the outline of
Midgaard to the far east.  Sounds of joyful celebration are heard from the
fields west of here.  The Brandywine flows by lazily nearby.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1126 to 1122

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1126 to 1128

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Took Hill

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a grassy field--nothing to get too excited about.  The field
extends toward the south and the west.  To the east you see Took Hill.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1127 to 1128

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Northern end of grassy field

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the center of a grassy field.  A great birthday party appears
to be taking place.  Great tables of food are spread out and a young halfling
beauty offers you welcome.  You are enticed by her generosity and suggestive
winks.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1128 to 1127

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small hill to the east blocks your view.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1128 to 1126

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1128 to 1129

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1128 to 1130

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A grassy field

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a grassy field--nothing to get too excited about.  The field
extends toward the north and the west.  To the east you see Took Hill.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1129 to 1128

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Southern end of grassy field

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a grassy field--nothing to get too excited about.  The field
extends every which way but west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1130 to 1128

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Western end of grassy field

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on a solidly built bridge.  As you look down you spy gaily
colored fish swimming with the current of Brandywine River.  The cool water
looks invitingly refreshing and you get a sudden urge to strip and bathe in
the river, but you hear the laughter of women nearby and so resist the urge.
Delving Lane extends to the north while Bywater Road can be seen to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Delving Lane.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1131 to 1132

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the south runs Bywater Road.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1131 to 1120

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Brandywine Bridge

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Delving Lane runs north and south in this small borough of the Shire.  To
the south stands Brandywine Bridge.  The Green Dragon, the undisputed leader
in the art of innkeeping, offers rest and comfort to the east.  You hear the
bray of horses from the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Delving Lane.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1132 to 1133

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Green Dragon offers food, drink, and above all hospitality for mere gold.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1132 to 1144

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Brandywine Bridge offers safe passage across the tumultuous river.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1132 to 1131

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Delving Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Delving Lane runs north and south in this small borough of the Shire.  A
large, imposing building lies to the east.  You hear the bray of horses from
the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Delving Lane.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1133 to 1134

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A large, imposing building lies to the east.  A sign reads 'Shiriff Post'.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1133 to 1145

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Delving Lane.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1133 to 1132

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a grassy field.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1133 to 1138

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Delving Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Delving Lane runs north and south in this small borough of the Shire. There
is a small house to the west, nothing to the east, and up ahead you see a round
door which leads to a rather impressive abode.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
A large, magnificent house meets your steady gaze.  Above the round door a
sign reads 'Bag End'.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1134 to 1135

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Delving Lane.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1134 to 1133

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Delving Lane

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in a comfortably well-equipped house, a palace by humble halfling
standards.  On the wall you see a banner which reads "Home Sweet Home".
A solid oak door to the east leads to a pantry while you see a cozy bedroom
to the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Through the keyhole you see what looks like a well stocked pantry.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 1135 to 1137

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Delving Lane.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1135 to 1134

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a bedroom.  It looks like the beds have recently been slept in.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1135 to 1136

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bag End

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the private bedroom of Bag End.  There are two beds to the
side, neither of which are made.  Portraits of halflings hang on the wall,
and as you gaze upon them you come to the conclusion that the owner of
Bag End comes from a long line of distinguished halflings.  A cozy fire
in the fireplace keeps the room warm and comfortable.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Through the doorway you see the main room of Bag End.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1136 to 1135

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Bedroom

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside the pantry.  Shelves filled with food and drink surround
you on all sides.  You wonder why a halfling would need so much to eat.
The presence of something unseen chills you to your bones.  On the floor
you spy a trapdoor.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Beyond the door you see the main room of Bag End.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door 1137 to 1135

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It's anyone's guess as to where the trapdoor leads.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1137 to 1156

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Pantry

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand upon a grassy field.  A bull stands grazing not far away and
out of the corner of your eye you can see him considering you.  The sound
of animals fill the air from the north.  To the south you see a pig pen.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a large barn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1138 to 1142

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see Delving Lane.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1138 to 1133

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A rather large pig pen is to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1138 to 1139

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A grassy field

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You feel your boots sinking into the mud.  Numerous pigs roam about,
oblivious to your company.  A grassy field is to the north while you see
a small path winding to the west.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A stony path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand inside a modest home.  You deduce that this is indeed the home
of whomever owns the surrounding lands.  The air is somewhat musty and
the smell reminds you of a stable.  As you look around disdainfully, you
think to yourself that this is more of a shack than a proper residence and
you long for the urban riches of the Shire proper.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small path winding its way southward.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1141 to 1140

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Gamgee Residence

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Animals of every sort fill the small barn.  You feel the hot breath of
horses and cows on your neck and you feel the sudden need for fresh air.
Other than that, you feel cozy and protected and don't mind staying for a
bit longer.  All the warmth and good vibes remind you of the days when your
mother would hold you in her arms and sing you to sleep.  You find yourself
wanting to cradle all the animals.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A chicken coop

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Welcome to the Green Dragon, the undisputed leader in the art of
innkeeping.  A rather charming and friendly hostess stands to the side,
ready to offer you food and drink.  While most of the patrons are halfling
locals, you spy an occasional human or two.  As you listen more closely
to the conversations that fill the inn, you hear the tales of great and
seasoned adventurers as well as the usual gossip.  You feel as if you've
found your second home in the Green Dragon.  You see a stairway leading
upwards.
